tasks.title: Design one-page Configuration versions and deployment
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Prepare the user's requested backoffice Configuration version-list model in the accepted desktop identity: one Configuration page, readable immutable saved versions, exact Deployed row, inspect/edit-copy/save and Deploy any retained version for rollback, with a single meaningful deployment confirmation. Preview normal list, edit/save, deployment and narrow desktop states. Keep native coherent-version/original/session/grant/ETag and truthful assignment-versus-recipient observations explicit in the technical contract while removing implementation vocabulary/screens from the normal flow. Record exact synthetic renderer/PNG hashes and request the user's screenshot decision. Do not implement or self-approve the new workflow.
tasks.validation: Inspect every rendered desktop frame including a narrow editor/list; verify dimensions/nonblank output and the stable version/selection/deployment semantics through independent review. Preserve R07/R08 and earlier R09 proposals as historical; all actors/intake/render/docs/review share one finite owner. No live-user draft mutation, new dependencies or broad campaign.

tasks.title: Implement approved Configuration version saving deployment and rollback
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: After exact R09 screenshot approval, implement one Configuration page with actual immutable coherent saved versions, exact deployed selection, local JSON editing/save and Deploy any saved version including rollback. Reuse existing native setup/publication/release/whole-map clients with separate originals, actual current grants/session, exact bytes and fresh reviewed ETags; Save never silently deploys and Deploy explicitly replaces targeting for this configuration after the all-instance review. Preserve known committed stages and recovery on partial/unknown results without new-key replay or reload continuation. Correct the duplicate creation/editor dirty ownership and Back/breadcrumb/deploy navigation with one discard decision, and contain/rescale the actual editor and list at changing desktop widths. No new backend/framework/counter or normal canary/release/assignment maze.
tasks.validation: Use existing pure and real native fixtures to verify saved history and deployed selection, exact pair rollback, single user Save with distinct native effects and truthful partial/recovery, no assignment after Save, whole-map replacement only after Deploy confirmation, conflict/session/read-only denial, exact large-number/Unicode bytes, new-name handoff, one canceled/accepted dirty navigation, and editor/list geometry at narrow/wide changing desktop viewports. Include scoped builds, docs, independent review and actual cleanup. Preserve earlier Windows Node failures and historical evidence; no broad qualification or Scheduler work.
